Indefinite mann is singular subject of mæg; nāhwæðer plus ne...ne excludes both infinitive activities. Cook89a supplies the full pronoun; BT Supplement646 independently attests the equivalent contracted nāðer with paired negated infinitives under mihte. All ellipsis, future use and negative coordination are supplied together.
